name: piko
description: Language support for Piko single-file components (.pk and .pkc): template intelligence, Go script blocks through gopls, and TypeScript client scripts

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Piko ignores workspace-level settings that choose which executables to run or which server to connect to.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Piko needs a local file system to run pikopls and Go.

piko.lspPath.markdownDescription: Custom path to the `pikopls` binary. Leave empty to use the bundled binary. Supports `~`, `${userHome}` and `${workspaceFolder}`; a bare name such as `pikopls` is looked up on `PATH`, and relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Ignored at workspace level in untrusted workspaces.

piko.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the Piko language server for debugging.

piko.enableTemplateSupport.description: Enable Piko LSP for <template> blocks. Disable if experiencing issues.

piko.useExternalServer.description: Connect to an already-running pikopls on a TCP port instead of starting one. For debugging.

piko.externalServerPort.description: Port of the external LSP server (used when useExternalServer is enabled).

enumDescriptions: Start pikopls on a local TCP port, limited to one connection. For debugging only.
piko.transport.description: How the extension talks to the pikopls language server.

piko.enablePprof.markdownDescription: Enable the pprof profiling server for pikopls. Access it at `http://localhost:<port>/_piko/debug/pprof/`. For debugging only.

piko.pprofPort.description: Port for the pprof HTTP server (used when enablePprof is enabled).

piko.enableFormatting.description: Enable document formatting from the Piko LSP server.

piko.enableFileLogging.markdownDescription: Write pikopls debug logs to `pikopls.log` in the extension's log directory. Open it with **Piko: Open LSP Logs**. Useful for debugging LSP issues.

piko.goBinPath.markdownDescription: Path to the directory containing the Go binary (e.g., `/usr/local/go/bin`). Leave empty for auto-detection.

piko.detectGoFromExtension.description: Detect the Go path from the VS Code Go extension settings (go.goroot, go.alternateTools).

piko.searchGlobalGoLocations.markdownDescription: When `go` is not on `PATH`, search common Go installation locations such as `/usr/local/go/bin`, Homebrew paths and `~/sdk/go*/bin` (newest version first).

piko.goplsPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `gopls` executable used for Go script blocks. Leave empty to let pikopls find it on `PATH` or in the Go bin directories. Supports `~`, `${userHome}` and `${workspaceFolder}`. Ignored at workspace level in untrusted workspaces.

piko.goplsDisable.description: Disable the gopls bridge, so Go script blocks get no Go completions, hover or diagnostics from gopls.

piko.goplsMaxChildren.markdownDescription: Maximum number of concurrent `gopls` child processes. `0` uses the server default; raise it for large multi-module workspaces.

piko.goplsMaxOverlays.markdownDescription: Maximum number of open Go-block overlays per `gopls` child. `0` uses the server default.

scripts.copy:types: mkdir -p src/fallbackTypes && cp ../../internal/typegen/typegen_frontend/built/piko-ide.d.ts src/fallbackTypes/piko-ide.txt && cp ../../internal/typegen/typegen_adapters/embedded/piko-actions-stub.d.ts src/fallbackTypes/piko-actions.txt
scripts.compile:production: rm -rf out && npm run copy:types && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:typecheck && npm run lint:cpd
scripts.test:grammar: vscode-tmgrammar-test -g test/grammar/stubs/html.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/stubs/go.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/stubs/ts.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/stubs/js.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/stubs/css.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/stubs/json.tmLanguage.json -g test/grammar/stubs/yaml.tmLanguage.json "test/grammar/**/*.test.pk"
